description: This file is a Spring MVC Controller class responsible for handling web requests related to 'Contract' entities, including creating, accepting, and printing contracts.

classes.name: ContractController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller managing contractual operations, including creation, acceptance, and printing of contracts.

methods.name: newContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests to render the form for creating a new contract for a specific client.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new contract, validate input, and determine whether to save or send to supervisor.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests for a user to accept a specific contract if authorized.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests to print a contract if it has been accepted, catching exceptions if the print file is missing.
